question: All of the following are true about Nizatidine except

options.opa: It is a H2 blocker used in peptic ulcer disease
options.opd: It can also lead to tachycardia

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Nizatidine" -> "H2 blocker" -> "used in peptic ulcer disease" -> 95%
analysis: Nizatidine is a histamine H2 receptor antagonist used in the treatment of peptic ulcer disease, which confirms that Option A is true. The bioavailability of Nizatidine is not 100%; it is typically around 70%, which makes Option B incorrect. There is no substantial evidence to support that Nizatidine enhances gastric emptying, making Option C unlikely. Tachycardia is not a common side effect of Nizatidine, but it can occur, making Option D less definitive. Therefore, the statement that is not true about Nizatidine is that it has 100% bioavailability, which aligns with standard medical knowledge.
